candidate_relations.reason: The candidate identifies cutaneous malakoplakia, which is the exact diagnostic entity in the reference. The addition of 'due to E. coli infection' is consistent with the positive bacterial culture result in the clinical record and does not conflict with the reference diagnosis; E. coli is the classic causative organism in malakoplakia. All histopathological hallmarks (Michaelis-Gutmann bodies, histiocytic sheets, Prussian blue and Von Kossa positivity, plasma cell background) are present and support this diagnosis.
